overall: The AG found no evidence that a quorum of the Arlington School Committee deliberated outside a meeting via Facebook, and declined to audit broader social media activity.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a quorum of the School Committee deliberated outside a meeting via Facebook groups that discuss committee business.
allegations.key_passage: For the reasons stated above, we find no evidence that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by deliberating outside of a meeting.

allegations.summary: Whether members' posts on a public Facebook group, and a quorum's membership in a closed group, amounted to deliberation.
allegations.key_passage: Here, we find that the posts by individual Committee members were directed to members of the public with Arlington School Enrollment Parent Group Facebook accounts, rather than specifically to a quorum of the Committee.

allegations.summary: Complainant asked that other numerous member posts on the Facebook groups be investigated, a broader audit request.
allegations.key_passage: We do not conduct broad audits of a public body and thus limit our review to the evidence presented to us in the complaint.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
